summary: This Form 8-K reports Verizon Master Trust's entry into an underwriting agreement for a routine securitization issuance of Series 2026-2 asset-backed notes totaling $1.2 billion across four classes. The transaction is a standard ABS offering by a special-purpose vehicle, not a special situation like a merger, tender, or restructuring. No premium, board recommendation, or activist involvement exists. The filing describes the note issuance and related indenture and account control agreements. No special-situation event is triggered; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
